source: mandelbrot3_smooth, authored as 13 control points as the albedo of the mandelbrot3_smooth reference (commons_Mandelbrot_3_Xo_C3_A1y_B_C3_A1nh_Ng_E1_BB_8Dt.png), in the order its bands run from the far field inwards: cream white, taupe beige, salmon pink, slate lavender, pale lavender, near-white, saturated gold, bronze olive, pale lemon and beige: the far field's pale bands and the bulbs' gold-salmon-lavender alternation, the gold held to a fifth of the map; cyclic, every stop more saturated than the reference's pixels, which the tone pass pulls towards grey.
